tagline: Transform emails into structured Notion pages and databases
metaTitle: Notion Gmail Integration: Save Emails and Action Items
metaDescription: Log client emails and pull action items from Gmail threads into Notion. GAIA updates existing pages or creates new ones. See the setup steps.
intro:
This integration turns emails into workspace content: a client email becomes a database entry, a project update becomes a page, a request becomes a task, with the important parts pulled out instead of pasted in whole. GAIA does this with plain-English workflows that read your inbox and write to your workspace, either automatically when new mail arrives or when you ask in chat.

GAIA connects both tools so important email content flows automatically into your knowledge management system. Client emails become structured database entries. Project update threads get converted into linked pages with proper context. Research compiled over email gets organized into searchable documents.

The result is an inbox that feeds your knowledge base rather than competing with it. Information captured in email becomes accessible in the workspace without the manual work of copy-pasting and reformatting.

Setting it up: connect both accounts, then create a workflow with the Gmail new-message trigger and describe the rule, for example: "When an email arrives from a client domain, add a row to the Clients database with the sender, date, a three-line summary and any action items, and append the summary to that client's page if one exists." For one-off saves, just ask in chat: "save the thread from Maria about the Q3 budget to my Finance page."

Limits worth knowing: GAIA writes text, properties and links into the workspace; attachments are summarized or linked rather than uploaded. It can only write to the pages and databases you share with it when you authorize access. If you just want to read and sort mail in a Notion-style app, Notion Mail (an email client for Gmail) covers that; GAIA is for filing email content into your workspace and acting on it.

useCases.title: Client communication log
useCases.description: GAIA automatically creates a database entry for each significant client email, including sender, date, key points, and action items extracted by AI, giving your team a searchable client communication history.

useCases.title: Project update capture
useCases.description: Status update emails from stakeholders and vendors get converted into structured pages linked to the relevant project, keeping your project documentation up to date without manual effort.

useCases.title: Action item extraction
useCases.description: GAIA reads incoming emails, identifies commitments and action items, and adds them as tasks to your workspace so nothing gets buried in your inbox.

useCases.title: Meeting notes from email threads
useCases.description: When a meeting is confirmed over email, GAIA creates a page pre-populated with attendees, agenda items mentioned in the email chain, and a space for notes.

useCases.title: Research email archive
useCases.description: Newsletter and research emails you mark for reading get saved to a structured database with AI-generated summaries so you can find and reference them later without digging through the inbox.

howItWorks.step: Connect Gmail and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate both accounts in GAIA. At that point, GAIA will ask which workspace and databases it should have access to write to.

howItWorks.step: Map email types to databases and pages
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which types of emails should go to which databases or pages. You can use labels, senders, keywords, or AI classification to categorize incoming email.
GAIA begins routing emails automatically. You can review what it creates and give feedback to improve accuracy. Most workflows are fully automated within a day or two of setup.

faqs.question: Can GAIA update existing pages or only create new ones?
faqs.answer: It can do both. It can create new database entries for each email or append information to an existing page. For example, follow-up emails from the same client can be appended to their existing contact page rather than creating duplicates.

faqs.question: Will GAIA extract attachments from emails into the workspace?
faqs.answer: It can reference attachments and summarize their content, but uploading binary files directly depends on your plan's storage limits. It will note attachment details and can store links to them.

faqs.question: Does this work with team workspaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can write to shared workspaces so email intelligence is available to your whole team. Each team member can connect their own inbox, and GAIA will route their emails to the shared workspace.

faqs.question: How do I connect Gmail to Notion?
faqs.answer: Connect both accounts in GAIA (the workspace asks which pages and databases to share), then either ask GAIA in chat to save a specific email, or create a workflow with the new-message email trigger that says which emails go where in the workspace. No copy-paste and no separate automation tool.

faqs.question: Can I automate this without Zapier?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's workflows run on its own email trigger, so a new email can create or update a page without a separate automation tool. Instead of a fixed field mapping, GAIA reads each email and extracts what your instructions ask for, such as a summary, a due date or the client name.

faqs.question: Can GAIA save emails I have already received?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to search the inbox, for example every email from a vendor this quarter, and it creates one entry per email or a single summary page. A scheduled workflow can also sweep a label into the workspace every day.
